subject: Staggered availability + rotating demo plan (confirming schedule)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Simon Wu <simon.wu@acmeiot.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 23:03:00 +0000
Subject: Initial: Redwood product demo — multi-stakeholder scheduling

Hi Simon —

Thanks again for the intro. Quick note to schedule a 60-minute demo for your engineering, security, and procurement teams so we can:
- Walk through latency/cost controls and dedicated deployment options
- Surface security controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs) for procurement/security
- Align on next steps and any evidence you need before procurement sign-off

We're trying to accommodate global stakeholders. Proposed 1-hour windows (all in UTC):
- Option A: Tue 2026-12-07 16:00–17:00 UTC (US-friendly)
- Option B: Wed 2026-12-08 08:00–09:00 UTC (APAC-friendly)
- Option C: Thu 2026-12-09 13:00–14:00 UTC (EU-friendly)

If none of those work, we can do a rotating weekly cadence (rotate who gets the favorable local time). Ava (SE) is cc'd for technical coverage. Agenda draft attached (RLW-demo-agenda.pdf).

Can you confirm who from Acme will join (engineering/security/procurement) and which option you prefer? If helpful, I can create a set of invites that rotate times across three weeks so everyone gets a suitable slot.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

[Attachment: RLW-demo-agenda.pdf (3 pages)]

From: Simon Wu <simon.wu@acmeiot.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@telco-solutions.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acmeiot.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial: Redwood product demo — multi-stakeholder scheduling

Ben —

Appreciate the options. Quick constraints from our side:
- Engineering (me + Rajiv): best windows are 15:00–18:00 PST (23:00–02:00 UTC) — usually late for EU/APAC folks.
- Security (Priya): prefers 12:00–16:00 UTC (afternoon EU / morning US).
- Procurement (Priya cc'd) needs at least one session during a US-friendly morning so they can route PO items same day.

Given the spread, a rotating approach sounds best. If we rotate weekly, please ensure one of the slots falls in Priya's 12:00–16:00 UTC window at least once in the first two weeks so procurement can move fast.

Also, please include a note in the invite about whether recordings will be available and whether any sensitive config will be shown — security will need that to approve attendance.

Simon
Director of Platform Engineering, Acme IoT
simon.wu@acmeiot.com

Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 11:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial: Redwood product demo — multi-stakeholder scheduling

Simon / Ben —

SE availability (UTC):
- Tue/Wed 16:00–19:00 UTC (best)
- Fri 12:00–14:00 UTC (ok for a shorter window)

I can run a standard demo + short live Q&A and record the session. For anything that touches config or customer data flows we'll keep screenshots and sanitized examples; we won't show live customer configs. Diego can run the deployment/infra questions if needed.

If you want a rotating calendar, I suggest a 3-week rotation:
Week 1: APAC-friendly (08:00–09:00 UTC)
Week 2: EU-friendly (13:00–14:00 UTC)
Week 3: US-friendly (23:00–00:00 UTC)

That ensures each stakeholder gets one session at a reasonable local hour within a three-week window.

-Ava
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0198

Thanks everyone — based on availability I put together a concrete rotating plan. Summary below (all times UTC):
- Session 1 (APAC-focused): Wed 2026-12-08 08:00–09:00 UTC — recording available
- Session 2 (EU-focused): Thu 2026-12-16 13:00–14:00 UTC — covers procurement/security
- Session 3 (US-focused): Wed 2026-12-22 23:00–00:00 UTC — engineering live deep-dive

Notes and asks:
- Priya: Per your ask, Session 2 lands in your 12:00–16:00 UTC window so procurement can attend during working hours.
- We will record Sessions 1 and 2 and sanitize any config screenshots; Session 3 will be recorded on request (engineering deep-dive).
- Diego will handle infra Q&A; Ava will run the demo.

I've attached a rotating-schedule.ics with three invites and included a Doodle link in case you prefer alternate slots: https://doodle.com/poll/rotating-demo-availability-ACME

Please reply with any conflicts by EOD Monday and I'll rework the slots. If no objections, I will send calendar invites and a short pre-demo checklist (access/attendee list).

Thanks,
Ben

[Attachment: rotating-schedule.ics]
